bpmn:textAnnotation.bpmn:text: Needs all required fields, at least 1 valid image and no active moderation hold (FR-07, FR-09, FR-39). With a hold, publishing stays refused until an Admin releases it (UC-08 2a). A Removed listing cannot be published with the normal action (UC-08 1b).

Account may hold both public roles. One conversation per Home Seeker/listing; reuse history; different listings have separate conversations. Reject own-listing conversations, viewing requests and reports by requesting account ID. Viewing requests need Published + Available; max one Pending per listing; retry after Rejected/Cancelled, while Accepted follows existing workflow. Authenticated Home Seekers may report another owner's Published listing; Property Owner-only cannot. Admin/Moderators review. Visitor is unauthenticated, not a role. Report status is separate from listing lifecycle. Feedback leaves listing unchanged; unpublishing preserves report status. Actions are independent and both may apply.
Missing data shown as unknown; availability label, last-confirmed and last-updated dates shown (FR-20, FR-21, BR-05, BR-11)

OD-01 confirmed: every Published listing has an availability confirmation date. The scheduled task sends in-app reminders on Day 5 and Day 7; after 7 days without response it sets Needs Reconfirmation. The owner dashboard shows a pending notice with Still Available and Not Available actions. Either action updates the confirmation date and availability; last-updated remains separate. User-visible content or image changes refresh updated_at; availability reconfirmation alone does not. Email reminders are planned subject to Q-02.

Login gate. Basis: FR-14 and UC-11 6a (ask to log in, return to property details), UC-14 1a, UC-18 2a (refused without login), UC-23 1a and FR-37. UC-20 names login only as a precondition and has no "not logged in" flow: documentation gap, left as is.
Max 3 properties; missing data stays blank; no "best" pick declared (FR-26 to FR-28, BR-07)

OD-05 confirmed default: a Home Seeker can cancel their own Pending viewing request (status Cancelled); past date/time requests are rejected; no minimum notice or owner response deadline in the initial release. Confirmed in FR-35, FR-36, FR-44, BR-09, UC-21, UC-22 and UC-30.
Dashboard shows only the owner's own listings, each with publication status and availability status (FR-43, BR-02, UC-29). Another owner's listings are refused (UC-29 2b).
